scripts.copy: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp public/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp public/manage.html dist/manage.html && cp public/content.css dist/content.css && cp public/manage.css dist/manage.css
scripts.build: esbuild src/content.ts src/popup.ts src/manage.tsx --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --sourcemap --jsx=automatic && npm run copy
scripts.watch: npm run copy && esbuild src/content.ts src/popup.ts src/manage.tsx --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --sourcemap --jsx=automatic --watch=forever
